description: Author multiple-choice quizzes, then take them with instant scoring.

faqs.a: Click Author mode, add questions with 4 options and mark the correct one. Switch to Take mode to answer and get scored.
faqs.q: How do I create and take a quiz?

faqs.a: Each question needs its text, all four options filled, and exactly one correct answer selected.
faqs.q: What does a valid question need?

faqs.a: The score screen shows your %, and each question marked right or wrong with the correct answer revealed.
In this browser's localStorage — the quiz you author is saved between visits.

howto: Stay in Author mode and add questions with 4 options each.
Mark the correct option for each question.
Switch to Take Quiz mode and answer all questions.
Submit to see your score with answer review.
title: Quiz Maker
